Introduction

Kim Hyeon Seo, formerly known as Antonio, is a South Korean-American trainee under Jellyfish Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival show Boys II Planet.

He was previously a member of the project boy group Nonstop under Rainbow E&M as part of the Future Idol project. He is also a former member of the male crew KAILAS.
